text:
laura: Quick standup re: Wed launch. Need final decisions on A/B reg page, join options, recording retention, and post-event nurture cadence.

 tom: For A/B test: Variant A = short form (email, company, role), Variant B = short + 1 free-text Q ('what problem are you solving?'). Run 50/50 for first 48 hours then pick winner on conversion and lead quality.

 emily: +1. Add hidden field for campaign_id so we can attribute. Also suggest we test two confirmation CTAs: "Join live" (with WebRTC) and "Watch on-demand". Measure which drives live attendance.

 ryan: Join options: primary = Zoom meeting link with passcode; fallback 1 = embedded WebRTC viewer (our player) if Zoom fails; fallback 2 = low-latency HLS via CDN for large regional audiences. We'll include alt 'dial-in' numbers for phone-only users.

 laura: Ops constraints: can we keep HLS ready but not public by default? Only flip the CDN if WebRTC reports >20% failure in a region.

 ops-bot: runbook note created: event/3182468000/runbook.md -> includes HLS standby flag and region failure thresholds.

 tom: Recording policy: raw recording -> store in S3 (30 days), trimmed highlights -> evergreen in assets bucket (1 year). Need legal sign-off for retention >90 days. Can we auto-generate 3 x 60s highlights within 3 hours?

 emily: We can. Plan: immediately after stream end, trigger job `assets/highlights-gen:v2` that uses speaker timestamps + NER to pick candidate clips. Editorial will finalize.

 ryan: Captions & compliance: captions must be available in SRT within 45 minutes. We should also export a redacted transcript option for requests (PII removal). Add a checkbox on reg form: 'Allow transcript contains my questions' opt-in.

 laura: Good. For post-event nurture: Sequence A (attended): 1hr follow-up email with recording + CTA to book demo. Sequence B (registered but no-show): teaser highlights + 24h nurture then demo CTA at 3 days. Sequence C (partner leads): route immediately to partner ops with full verbatim transcript.

 tom: CRM integration: webhook payload example: `POST /webhooks/event` body: {"event_id":"3182468000","email":"{{email}}","attended":{{attended}},"consent_transcript":{{consent}}}`. Make sure consent flags map to GDPR fields.

 emily: A/B test metric: primary = live attendance rate; secondary = downstream SQLs in 14 days. Also capture 'requests demo' from free-text via keyword parse.

 ryan: Clip priority rubric idea: score = (speaker weight * 2) + (NER product hit * 3) + (audience type weight). Tier A threshold >=8, Tier B 5-7, Tier C <=4. We'll surface top 10 Tier A for sales follow-up.

 laura: Who's owning clip editorial? emily: Marketing will pick, Sales will tag which are sales-ready. We'll keep a shared sheet with timestamps and suggested titles.

 ops-bot: scheduled job test: greenroom-check at 2024-06-05T16:00:00Z. Includes: caption pipeline test, fallback WebRTC failover simulation, HLS enable toggle.

 tom: Preflight checklist: 1) confirm co-hosts and breakout pre-assignments, 2) verify captions enabled in Zoom + SRT ingest, 3) confirm webhook to CRM with test row, 4) run A/B traffic split test endpoint, 5) verify confirmation email contains fallback links.

 emily: I'll draft two confirmation email variants and share in #marketing-drafts. laura: can you review the privacy text? We must not pre-check partner opt-ins.

 laura: Will review. Also add a small script to ping reps 10m after start if registrant hasn't joined: `curl -X POST https://crm.redwood.ai/events/3182468000/ping-nonjoiners -d '{"minutes":10}'`

 ryan: Can ops ensure phone dial-in numbers are geo-fenced correctly? We had misrouted PST numbers last time.

 ops-bot: dial-in lookup updated for regions: NA, EU, APAC. Test vectors added to runbook.

 laura: Final action items: tom -> implement hidden campaign_id + A/B split logic by EOD. emily -> confirmation emails + drafts in docs by 10am PT Tue. ryan -> ensure caption SRT SLA and HLS standby config. ops-bot -> greenroom test scheduled and runbook updated.

 laura: Thanks everyone. If anything pops up during greenroom, post here and tag ops-bot. :rocket:
